id: 51_What are hazardous materials & how are they classified trending hazardous biosaf
title: 危险物品怎么分类：九大类与象形图
source_doc: course/Microbiology Biosafety/51_What are hazardous materials & how are they classified trending hazardous biosaf.md
author_source: project/Microbiology Biosafety/51_What are hazardous materials & how are they classified trending hazardous biosaf/src.py

points.K1: 危险物品：伤人、毁物、污染环境
points.K3: 联合国规定：运输分九类
points.K8: 第 5 类：氧化性物质和有机过氧化物
points.K9: 第 6 类：毒性物质和感染性物质
points.K12: 第 9 类：杂项危险物品
points.K13: 象形图：通用的危害图形语言

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一面贴满红框菱形象形图的墙前，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a wall covered with GHS hazard pictograms and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 危险物品这么多，怎么分门别类？
overlay: 危险物品怎么分类：九大类与象形图

shots.scene: 九个空白格子排成三行三列，依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: Nine blank boxes arranged in three rows of three light up one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 今天认识九大类和它们的标志。

shots.scene: 阿杰面对满柜贴着菱形标志的试剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands before a cabinet full of reagent bottles with red-bordered diamond symbols.
shots.narration: 阿杰看着满柜子的菱形标志。

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，头顶几个问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head with several question marks above him.
shots.narration: 他问：危险物品到底怎么分类？

shots.scene: 欣欣出现，拿着两张卡片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot appears holding two blank cards.
shots.narration: 欣欣说：先从分类讲起。

shots.section_title: 危险物品：伤人、毁物、污染环境
shots.scene: 人体、房屋、河流三个图标，各连一个警示三角
shots.prompt_en: Three icons, a human figure, a house and a river, each linked to a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 危险物品，会伤人、毁物、污染环境。
overlay: 危险物品：伤人、毁物、污染环境

shots.scene: 七个圆形图标依次出现：火焰、腐蚀、骷髅、爆炸、辐射、生物危害、气瓶
shots.prompt_en: Seven round icons appear one by one: flame, corrosion, skull, explosion, radiation trefoil, biohazard, gas cylinder. No people.
shots.narration: 按物理和化学危险，分成几组。

shots.scene: 七个图标下方出现中文标签
shots.prompt_en: The seven icons line up in a row with blank label strips beneath them. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃、腐蚀、有毒、反应、放射。

shots.scene: 最后两个图标放大
shots.prompt_en: The biohazard icon and the gas cylinder icon enlarge. No people.
shots.narration: 还有生物危害和压缩气体。

shots.section_title: 联合国规定：运输分九类
shots.scene: 卡车、轮船、飞机图标并排，货箱上贴菱形标签
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a truck, a ship and a plane side by side, each carrying a crate with dangerous goods labels. No people.
shots.narration: 为了安全运输，联合国规定了九类。
overlay: 联合国规定：运输分九类

shots.section_title: 联合国规定：运输分九类
shots.scene: 九个格子编号一到九依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: Nine boxes numbered one to nine light up in order. No people.
shots.narration: 我们按编号，一类一类看。

shots.scene: 数字一的格子亮起，里面是爆炸图形的菱形标签
shots.prompt_en: Box number one lights up showing an exploding bomb dangerous goods label. No people.
shots.narration: 第 1 类：爆炸品。

shots.scene: 数字二的格子亮起，里面是气瓶和火焰的菱形标签
shots.prompt_en: Box number two lights up showing gas cylinder and flame dangerous goods labels. No people.
shots.narration: 第 2 类：气体。

shots.scene: 数字三的格子亮起，里面是火焰菱形标签和溶剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: Box number three lights up showing a flame dangerous goods label and a solvent bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 第 3 类：易燃液体。

shots.scene: 数字四的格子亮起，里面是红白条纹火焰标签
shots.prompt_en: Box number four lights up showing a red and white striped flame dangerous goods label. No people.
shots.narration: 第 4 类：易燃固体。

shots.section_title: 第 5 类：氧化性物质和有机过氧化物
shots.scene: 数字五的格子亮起，里面是圆圈上火焰的黄色菱形标签
shots.prompt_en: Box number five lights up showing a yellow flame-over-circle dangerous goods label. No people.
shots.narration: 第 5 类：氧化性物质和有机过氧化物。
overlay: 第 5 类：氧化性物质和有机过氧化物

shots.section_title: 第 6 类：毒性物质和感染性物质
shots.scene: 数字六的格子亮起，里面是骷髅标签和生物危害标签
shots.prompt_en: Box number six lights up showing a skull dangerous goods label and a biohazard label. No people.
shots.narration: 第 6 类：毒性物质和感染性物质。
overlay: 第 6 类：毒性物质和感染性物质

shots.section_title: 第 6 类：毒性物质和感染性物质
shots.scene: 骷髅图标一侧，生物危害标志一侧
shots.prompt_en: A skull icon on one side and a biohazard symbol on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 有毒的化学品，和感染性物质。

shots.scene: 数字七的格子亮起，里面是三叶形辐射标签
shots.prompt_en: Box number seven lights up showing a radiation trefoil dangerous goods label. No people.
shots.narration: 第 7 类：放射性物质。

shots.scene: 数字八的格子亮起，里面是液滴滴在手和金属上的黑白标签
shots.prompt_en: Box number eight lights up showing a black and white corrosion dangerous goods label with drops on a hand and a metal bar. No people.
shots.narration: 第 8 类：腐蚀性物质。

shots.section_title: 第 9 类：杂项危险物品
shots.scene: 数字九的格子亮起，里面是上半黑色竖条的标签
shots.prompt_en: Box number nine lights up showing a dangerous goods label with black vertical stripes on the upper half. No people.
shots.narration: 第 9 类：杂项危险物品。
overlay: 第 9 类：杂项危险物品

shots.section_title: 象形图：通用的危害图形语言
shots.scene: 九个红框菱形象形图排成一圈
shots.prompt_en: Nine GHS hazard pictograms arranged in a circle. No people.
shots.narration: 红框菱形象形图，是通用的危害语言。
overlay: 象形图：通用的危害图形语言

shots.section_title: 象形图：通用的危害图形语言
shots.scene: 象形图分三组：物理、健康、环境
shots.prompt_en: The hazard pictograms are sorted into three groups with a flask icon, a human body icon and a tree icon. No people.
shots.narration: 分物理、健康、环境三方面危害。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，九个格子依次亮起前四个
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a whiteboard where the first four of nine boxes light up.
shots.narration: 爆炸品、气体、易燃液体、易燃固体。

shots.scene: 后五个格子亮起
shots.prompt_en: The remaining five boxes light up.
shots.narration: 氧化、毒性感染、放射、腐蚀、杂项。

shots.scene: 九个红框象形图排成一圈
shots.prompt_en: Nine red-bordered diamond pictograms arranged in a circle. No people.
shots.narration: 红框象形图，一看就懂。

shots.scene: 阿杰对着试剂柜一一认出象形图，小研竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The young male student points to each pictogram on the reagent bottles while the female graduate student gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：九类加象形图，我记住了！

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一张象形图卡片，向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a pictogram card and waves goodbye to the camera.
shots.narration: 认准标志，分类不乱，再见！
